description: This Java class defines a ScriptEventHandler for the OFBiz web framework, responsible for executing scripts or script functions in response to web events. It sets up the scripting environment with various context objects and handles the result, allowing scripts to interact with web request, response, session, and other contextual data.

classes.name: ScriptEventHandler
classes.description: A handler that executes scripting events within the OFBiz web framework, utilizing JSR-223 scripting APIs to run scripts or script functions based on web events.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the event handler with the provided ServletContext. Currently a no-op.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Executes a script or script function specified by an event, setting up the scripting environment with relevant web context objects, handling the execution, and returning the appropriate response code or error message.
